description: This is a PHP class file defining an XmlResponse class that extends a base Response class. It provides a way to generate HTTP responses containing XML content, with methods to handle the creation of the response body from a string or stream.

classes.name: XmlResponse
classes.description: A response class that encapsulates an XML payload, setting appropriate headers and response status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new XmlResponse with XML content, status code, and headers.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Creates and returns the message body as a StreamInterface; handles converting string or stream input.
